title: User Management
description: Members surface ported from superspace, props-driven + RBAC-agnostic. <MembersPanel>: searchable / role-filterable / sortable member table with avatar + name + email, inline role dropdown, soft-remove, and a permission-gated invite button. You pass `roles` (options) + `currentPerms` (resolved permission strings, wired from rbac-roles) + CRUD callbacks; the slice imports no other slice's frontend. Convex template ships um_members + listMembers (joins users) + addMember / updateMemberRole / removeMember, all gated via rbac-roles' requirePermission. P1 of the user-management epic — invites (P2) + roles admin (P3) next.

peers.reason: Roles + resolved permissions + the convex permission helpers (requirePermission, getActorPermissions).
Member identity (name/email/avatar) joined from the users table.
